reviews.text: Apparently the clinic is closed from 1pm to 4pm due to surgeries and other reasons. Google said they were open, so I called, but they were rude and told me they couldn't accept reservations at that time. I wish they would tell Google quickly and change the time. Many people get the wrong idea.

Thank you for always taking such good care of our dog. The doctors and staff are all very kind and knowledgeable, and they give us advice that is tailored to our dog's constitution, so it's a very reliable animal hospital! Our dog has had a sensitive stomach since he was a puppy, and we went to many different hospitals but it didn't get better. However, after trying the dietary therapy and treats that the doctor in charge here taught us, his constitution seems to have improved, and he hardly ever gets an upset stomach anymore. Our dog is also very attached to the doctors and always wants to go and say hello when we pass by on our walks lol. We look forward to continuing to use your services!
He is a wonderful doctor. I am grateful for the very thorough examination of my cat.
Thank you so much for your kind response and advice, even though I contacted you from outside the prefecture.

I rely on this veterinary clinic as my primary care provider. They offer reasonable prices and provide appropriate receipts according to my insurance company's policies.

They remember my pet's name and symptoms in detail and provide attentive care. This is a truly trustworthy animal hospital.

My teacher is young, but very kind.

Even for small things, they're happy to answer my questions via LINE, which is reassuring.

They also respond very quickly.

This is a very trustworthy hospital. They are also strong in obstetrics and have multiple doctors, so you can leave your child in their care with peace of mind.

They are very kind and helpful.
